description: "The Guerilla Chief, and Other Tales" by Mayne Reid is a historical fiction work written in the late 19th century. The narrative revolves around events set during the Mexican-American War, showcasing the experiences and thoughts of soldiers in the aftermath of battle, including themes of valor, conflict, and personal sacrifice.
